resultados.pregunta: Can you drop the executive-search fee from 22% to 15%?
resultados.answer:
I appreciate you bringing that up. Our standard executive-search fee is 22% of the role's gross annual salary, and that includes a 6‑month replacement guarantee and thorough reference verification—both of which reduce your risk of a bad hire. A reduction to 15% would be a discount below our standard fee, and per our policy, that kind of adjustment requires approval from our Managing Partner, Marcos Ibáñez. I can flag that request with him, but I can't confirm the lower rate without his sign‑off.

In the meantime, would you like me to walk through the full value behind our 22% fee, including how we protect your investment?

Sources: pricing-model — Executive headhunting
